items.title: Introducing Nomos Sandbox: A Decision Layer You Can Watch Work
items.summary: Nomos Sandbox is an interactive, public simulation of Nomos, our AI decision layer for logistics: request access, log in, and spend a session inside a working warehouse or sortation operation, watching decisions get made, questioned, and approved.

items.title: Production Simulation: A Benchmark for Planning Under Constraints
items.summary: We built a turn-based factory simulation to test how language models plan under interacting constraints. Across twenty solvable scenarios and nine model configurations, Claude Fable 5 leads every aggregate and is the only model to make multi-product coordination tractable, while reasoning effort, not model choice, is the largest single lever we measured.
